title: Create accessible collapsed-card type glyphs for ClearFront G1
description: Generate exactly three square transparent PNG type glyphs for ClearFront collapsed cards: Unit, Spell, and Relic. Maintain a consistent ClearFront fantasy-card visual family, strong silhouettes at 24-32px, and accessibility through shape rather than color. Do not edit ClearFront code, source provenance, rules, or any file outside the three registered assets.
acceptance_criteria: All three files are square 64-128px RGBA PNGs with transparent corners and no background, text, watermark, or cast shadow.
At 24px and 32px on a dark navy background, Unit reads as a blade/sword, Spell as a spark/star, and Relic as a gem/diamond through distinct silhouettes rather than color alone.
The glyphs form a consistent high-contrast ClearFront fantasy UI family and only the three registered asset files are added.
